_role: Rigid dirigible (Zeppelin register - RIGID, not blimp: HULL_MASSING_SPEC.md settled that, and the doped-fabric-over-frame read matches VISUAL_ART_DIRECTION's flat/low-metallic finish). Long tapered envelope, gondola slung BELOW on the centreline (the sidecar's underside_y_bias 0.6 is what hangs locomotion off it), longitudinal keel battens, and a tail-fin cross. The other hull the SDF pipeline genuinely suits - it is mostly one big smooth swept volume. NOTE: the longitudinal keel battens from the original spec were dropped - at 0.30 thick on a 15.5-long hull they are greeble-scale, not massing, and cannot survive Marching Cubes at any sane resolution. They belong in the greeble/module layer.

primitives._note: Main envelope - a long ellipsoid cigar. Slightly forward of centre so the tail taper has room behind it.
Tail taper - a smaller ellipsoid blended onto the stern so the envelope narrows toward the fins instead of ending bluntly.
Gondola slung under the envelope, biased toward the nose. Kept as a distinctly boxy volume against the smooth bag - that contrast IS the airship read.
Horizontal tail fin. Thickened to 0.9: at 0.28 it was far under one voxel on a 15.5-long hull and baked away to nothing.
Vertical tail fin - together with the horizontal one this is the fin cross. Thickened to 0.9: at 0.28 it was far under one voxel on a 15.5-long hull and baked away to nothing.
